body:
Part of #617. Machine data from a Sodick owner (spikeypineapple, **Sodick AQ600L**, LN control): the machine's condition table, exported as `COND.DAT` and posted on #617 ([COND.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/35214655/COND.txt), 68 KB, CRLF, unchanged). Machine data, not another CAM's output, so it is usable under the clean-room rules.

## What the table is

- 900 lines `Cnnn = f1 ... f15;`, quoted, CRLF. Header comment names the 15 fields: `ON OFF IP HRP MAO SV V SF C PIK CTRL WK WT WS WP`.
- Comment lines group the conditions by material, wire diameter and cut:

| Conditions | Section (as written in the file) |
|---|---|
| C100-C136 | WATER, SKD-11, wire 0.2 mm |
| C200-C230 | water, SKD-11, wire 0.25 mm |
| C400-C414 / C450-C479 | water, WC (carbide), wire 0.20 / 0.25 mm |
| C700-C719 / C750-C764 | water, AL, wire 0.20 / 0.25 mm |
| C800-C822 / C850-C867 | water, Cu, wire 0.20 / 0.25 mm |
| C480-C595 | 1st cut sets by wire (0.1 / 0.2 mm) and material (SKD11, WC) |
| C300-C395 | BS2, 2nd cut |
| C908-C938 / C909-C999 | BS2I-PKA, 3rd / 4th cut |
| C777, C888, C890-C893 | special (NEW4400 block) |

- `C120` appears twice with the same values.

## Why it matters now

Our post writes fixed condition numbers. The owner confirms that `C001` and `C002` **do** exist on his machine and are used for almost every pass, even though `COND.DAT` lists only `C100` and up. So the low numbers (`C000`-`C099`) come from somewhere else: written in the program, copied from this table into a working set, or a separate table. Asked on #617; his hand-written known-good program should show it. This issue must not assume a condition is missing just because it is not in `COND.DAT`.

## Wanted

- Read a `COND.DAT` (this format) into a condition library: number, the 15 fields, and the section it sits in (material, wire diameter, cut stage).
- The Sodick wire operation picks the rough and skim conditions from that library by material, wire diameter and pass, instead of fixed numbers; the post writes those numbers.
- A condition the loaded table and the working set (C000-C099, see above) both lack is refused by name before posting - only once we know where the working set comes from.
- Without a loaded table, today's behaviour stays (the header warns that each C must exist on the control).

The meaning of each field (IP, SV, WT ...) is not needed to pick by section; do not guess units for them. Ask the owner on #617 before adding his file to the repo as a test fixture; until then, a small synthetic file in the same format is enough for the tests.

Done means: a `COND.DAT` in this format loads (a test with a synthetic file in the same format, CRLF and quotes included); the 2-pass Sodick program picks its conditions from the loaded table by material, wire and pass; a condition missing from both the table and the working set is refused by name; with no table the output is byte-identical to today.
